# praxio

> praxio (CV Praxio Studio) is an architectural visualisation and design studio in Bali, Indonesia, run by Justin Lawless. It produces still renders, animated walkthroughs, 3D models, AI-assisted concept designs and technical drawings for architects, developers, interior designers and private clients worldwide, with unlimited revisions within scope and design input at every stage.

## Services
- Visualisation: still renders, animated walkthroughs, full project presentations for print or video
- 3D modelling from CAD, plans, sketches or photos; organic and parametric modelling
- Design: AI-assisted iterative concept design, masterplan development, interior mood boards and material selection
- Drawings and sourcing: floorplans, elevations, sections; sourcing of materials, furniture and fittings
- Projects can start from a full brief, from reference images, or from just an idea

## Pricing
- Free instant quote on the website in about a minute (price range); the exact fixed price follows after review: https://www.praxio.studio/#process

## Selected work
- Open Flame Kitchen (OFK), Al Hamra Tower & Mall, Kuwait City (2022): 540 m² restaurant interior design and rendering
- Al Nawah, Kuwait (2025): three-floor interior design
- Adel Villa, Kuwait (2025): villa interior redesign
- Atelier, Jakarta (2026): batik boutique concept
- Junichi Villa, Bogor (2026): tropical modern Japanese villa concept
- The Point, Jakarta (2026): apartment development concept
- Tamdeen Square, Kuwait (2022): outdoor restaurant complex
- K-Land resort; Chocomelt locations (Bahrain)

## About
- Justin Lawless: 18+ years in architecture and archviz; studied 2D animation and 3D modelling; started at a AAA video game studio. Tools: 3ds Max, Corona Renderer, AI-assisted workflows.
